theme: An open day before a full Wednesday.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia on PRI
needsAttention.detail: On the PRI thread, Eugenia has sent call times — Thursday among them — and is waiting for you to confirm which one works. It has been sitting since Aug 14.

needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is Thursday in Portland. The prep task is overdue: fill the prescriptions, stock soft food, and confirm the driver and coverage before then.

needsAttention.title: Ready for the Jomon call
needsAttention.detail: Your Zoom with Jomon Associates is confirmed for 8 PM tomorrow (morning in Tokyo). Worth arriving with a few talking points in hand.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer on the Maine coast has the farmstands at their peak, and a composed salad lets ripe tomatoes and briny French feta carry a warm, low-effort evening on your own.

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the morning is entirely open.
Still clear through the afternoon, a rare stretch of unclaimed time.
A quiet night before tomorrow fills up with Mike's two scans and the Tokyo call.
